name: product-doc
description: Visual documents to explain systems, plan work, and review changes
author: Tanishq Kancharla

scripts.semvariant:check: npm run semvariant -- check && tsc -p tools/semvariant/tsconfig.json && oxlint --deny-warnings tools/semvariant && oxfmt --check tools/semvariant && tsx --test tools/semvariant/semvariant.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run semvariant:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src vite.config.ts vite.gist.config.ts vite.viewer.config.ts bin.js
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix src vite.config.ts vite.gist.config.ts vite.viewer.config.ts bin.js
scripts.prepack: npm run build:viewer && npm run build:lib
scripts.pretest: npm run build:viewer && npm run build:lib
scripts.test: DIFFMAP_TELEMETRY=0 tsx --test src/spec.test.ts src/cli.test.ts src/update.test.ts src/parseViewer.test.ts src/git.test.ts src/serve.test.ts src/gist/route.test.ts src/github/route.test.ts src/github/patch.test.ts src/host/githubFailure.test.ts src/github/fetchRepo.test.ts src/viewer/sourceHeader.test.ts src/viewer/comments.test.ts src/viewer/serviceLayout.test.ts src/preview/preview.test.tsx src/viewer/previews/previews.test.ts
scripts.build:lib: node -e "fs.rmSync('lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
